input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the volume of air V_lab served by scrubber-1-t4 as V = Qe * tau, from the rise and decay of the occupants' CO2 in the Lab.

steps.why: Rise: reduce effective flow to 30% so the Lab CO2 climbs from 900 ppm towards a higher equilibrium (several hundred ppm above noise).
Decay: full speed, record the decay towards its equilibrium and fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau).

abort.when: the device refuses a step's command
state of charge under the threshold
a monitored person leaves the band, monitoring is lost, or one more person enters the Lab

monitoring.reason: The test raises the CO2 of the air the two Lab occupants breathe.

hypotheses: Hatch-1-t4 is held closed for the whole test; exchange through the closed hatch (station-topology design flow 3 m3/min hatch closed) is NOT measured and is a hypothesis; Hab-B CO2 is recorded to show whether it exchanges air.
The two Lab occupants stay, awake at constant activity (0.38 L/min each, 0.26 to 0.45); nobody enters or leaves.
Qe scales linearly with speed: 1 m3/min at 100 percent, 0.3 m3/min at 30 percent; lag 3.33 min is excluded from the fit start.
First guess of V is 30 m3 (default, 10 to 200), stated as a guess only: tau ~ 30 min at full speed, ~100 min at 30 percent.

expected.rise: From 900 ppm the Lab CO2 rises towards an equilibrium near 2700 ppm (G/Qe = 0.76 L/min / 0.3 m3/min ~ 2530 ppm above baseline); after 28 min about +450 ppm (~1350 ppm), well under co2MaxPpm 2800.
expected.decay: At full speed CO2 falls towards about 900 ppm with tau = V/Qe ~ 30 min for V = 30 m3; fitted V_lab = 1 m3/min * tau, expected in 10 to 200 m3.
expected.refutation: Hab-B CO2 moving in step with the Lab, a rise much slower than 0.76 L/min / V predicts, or a decay equilibrium far from 900 ppm shows hatch exchange or a different source; a fit residual not white shows the zone is not well mixed. Either invalidates V_lab.
expected.stop: CO2 reaching 3200 ppm, a refused command, low battery, or a vitals alarm stops the test.
